title: Untitled (Figure with Snowman)
description: Sparse ink line drawing of a standing figure dominates a pale, overexposed field of white and soft blue wash. At the lower center, a three-dimensional snowman sculpture element is affixed, topped with a small radiant motif; paired blue eyes are drawn at the figure's head.
composition: central figure with affixed sculptural snowman element
keywords: ink-line figure drawing with sculptural collage
